svg.text: The room inside the harness: plan, from above
Claude Code, mid-session. Back wall at the top; the camera looks in from the front. Purple numbers follow one turn.
Upstairs, far away: the model reads the copy and writes a reply
(the provider also runs its own tools up there: web search, fetch, code execution)
front edge: low and open to the camera
stacked in the wall, as on the cabinet
The tray: the context the model reads
frosted cover: cached, unchanged since last turn
open end: the next tile goes here
the lip: new tiles slide along it to the open end
camera: in front, a little right, 38° above
Seen from the front: up on the right, down on the left
roof (cut away here; you came in through its hatch)
The drawers fill the tray’s start: tools, instructions, your machine.
A copy of the whole tray rides the capsule up the tube. The tray stays here.
Far away upstairs, it reads the copy and writes a reply.
Tiles come down the chute into the tray; an amber call also sets off for the gate.
Words go out through the window; your prompts and answers come in.
An amber call is allowed, asked about (the bell), or refused.
At a port, on your machine; or in the subagent’s room.
Back along the groove and the lip into the tray. Then Send again.
All the time: every tile is copied to the records (the transcript, on disk).
When the tray nears its end stop, the press squeezes the conversation into
one summary block; the tray’s start stays as it was.
